_comment: AUREX WhatsApp Bot egg for PreBots. Install script clones the BOT_REPO env var set by the panel, then runs npm install. Import in Admin > Nests, then assign to each PreBot in Admin > Aurex > PreBots.
author: team@aurex
description: Node.js 20 egg for Aurex PreBots. Clones the bot repo from the BOT_REPO variable on install. Includes ffmpeg for sticker/media bots.
name: Aurex WhatsApp Bot

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Aurex WhatsApp Bot install - clones the repo from $BOT_REPO
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git ffmpeg > /dev/null 2>&1 || true

if [ -z "${BOT_REPO}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: BOT_REPO is not set. This egg must be deployed via the Aurex PreBots store."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Cloning ${BOT_REPO} ..."
git clone --depth=1 "${BOT_REPO}" bot_tmp
shopt -s dotglob
mv bot_tmp/* ./
rm -rf bot_tmp

if [ -f package.json ]; then
  echo "Installing dependencies..."
  npm install --no-audit --no-fund
fi

echo "Install complete: ${BOT_NAME:-WhatsApp Bot}"

variables.description: GitHub URL of the WhatsApp bot to install. Set automatically by the Aurex PreBots store.
variables.name: Bot Repository

variables.description: Display name of the bot. Set automatically by the Aurex PreBots store.
variables.name: Bot Name
